description: Every finite subset of the second-order noncompactness theory has a full model on the standard natural numbers, using a suitable interpretation of the fresh constant.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.noncompact_finite_standard_models
  (Δ :
    Finset
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.Formula
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.expandedLanguage))
  (hΔ : ↑Δ ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.noncompactTheory) :
  ∃ I,
    ∀ φ ∈ Δ,
      ∀ (a : ℕ → ℕ) (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment ℕ),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r φ
